title: 先把话写清楚
subtitle: 用清晰语言，降低阅读负担。
view:
借鉴 ASD-STE100，
也可先尝试约 80% 的简洁程度。
practice:
请用短句解释这个概念。
术语保持一致，保留事实与限定条件。
note: 中文借鉴清晰原则；80% 不是合规评分。
prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Create ONE finished Chinese social editorial infographic, portrait aspect ratio exactly 3:4, preferably 1536×2048. This is a five-card coherent series for WeChat Moments. A premium technical editorial aesthetic inspired by an engineering specification sheet: warm ivory paper, dark navy typography, ultramarine blue lines and panels, a tiny warm orange accent, precise fine-line diagrams, generous whitespace, very subtle square grid in selected diagram areas. NOT a dense screenshot, NOT a social media UI, NOT a collage of multiple posters. Strong oversized Chinese headline, highly readable Chinese sans-serif body, tidy monospace micro-labels only for small English technical tags. Phone-readable body. 7% safety margin. Diagram occupies about middle 40%, prompt callout lower 22%. No human portrait, no logos, no QR code. No invented quotes. No extra words. Exact copy provided below must be accurately typeset in simplified Chinese. All text including footnotes must be legible. This is editorial paraphrase, not a verbatim quotation. Header small: “KARPATHY · AI 理解指南”. Footer: “据 @karpathy 截图整理 · 非逐字引语” and on next line “广哥在硅谷 · 整理”. Keep these header/footer placements, typography, palette and grid consistent across the series. Render the requested card only.
